g.text: Ideal 90° turn geometry and saved native responses
Derived constant-radius arcs, not fitted trajectories | half-width w = 76.2 m
Black L = nominal rays; grey = Euclidean w-tube. Dotted segments join exact maximum witnesses to closest ray projections.
All three radii satisfy R − d ≤ min(L₁, L₂), with L₁ = L₂ = 4630 m. Geometry panels show local coordinates in metres.
Bounds exclude initial 45° capture, acceleration, guidance error and exit overrun. They concern this circular-arc family only;
they do not establish controller optimality, arbitrary-policy infeasibility, continuous native safety or novelty.
